_comment_experiment_type: name of the process from the backend config
_comment_yield_uncertainty: uncertainty of the yield, this is used to calculate the uncertainty of the yield in the bayesian optimization (in %)
_comment_acquisition_function: acquisition function for the bayesian optimization, can be one of: UpperConfidenceBound or ExpectedImprovement
_comment_beta: beta value for UCB in the bayesian optimization, this is the initial value
_comment_beta_decay_delay: delay of the beta decay, after this many iterations the beta decay will start
